summary.zh: 质疑架构押注、十倍扩容与自建取舍
summary.en: Challenge an architecture bet, a 10x scaling plan, or a rebuild call.

description.zh: 在做出架构押注、规划十倍流量增长，或决定重写还是采购之前，追问依据、总成本和失败代价。适合技术方案评审会前的自查。
description.en: Asks what the architecture bet rests on, what 10x scaling really costs, and whether rebuilding beats buying. Useful as a self-check before a technical design review.
